title: Faults, Safety Recalls and the Compliance Standing of a Keyturn Vehicle Listing
content:
A fault reported on a vehicle is recorded against the Keyturn Vehicle Listing whoever reported it, and a guest's report carries the same weight as a workshop's for the purpose of opening the record. The standing of the listing is read off the marketplace's own record before the fault record is opened, and is gathered to the vehicle by the listing the fault is recorded against: a fault is recorded on a listing under review, live, snoozed or suspended, and on no other.

What the report does next depends on the fault.

| What was found | What follows | How long the host has |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A safety fault | The listing is suspended at the end of the grace unless the fault is put right, and stays suspended until it is | The class's safety grace in whole elapsed hours counted from the report |
| An ordinary fault | The listing is suspended at the end of the period unless the fault is put right | The class's rectification period in whole calendar days |
| An open safety recall | The listing is suspended at once with no grace at all | The vehicle returns only when a recall clearance document has been verified |

The host's word that the recall work has been done is not a clearance.

Putting a fault right is evidenced by a fresh inspection record, not by the host marking it resolved, and a listing whose fault is still open at the end of its period is suspended rather than warned again.

A vehicle with more than 4 faults over the rolling twelve months goes to a compliance review however promptly each one was put right, because a pattern of faults is itself a finding.

A fault reported on a trip does not by itself make the guest liable for it, and liability is settled under the protection rules rather than by the fault record.

### Two readings of the compliance count

A vehicle carrying 4 faults over the rolling twelve months, every one of them put right within its period, does not go to compliance review on this ground: the clause bites above 4, not at 4. The same vehicle carrying 5 faults in that window goes to compliance review, and the promptness with which each was put right does not answer the finding.
